name: UDSM ARIS 3 v1.4.1
body:
## Home: year registration status replaces balance due

- The student card now leads with your **year registration status** — REGISTERED, PARTIALLY REGISTERED, NOT REGISTERED, GRADUATED or DISCONTINUED — derived live from ARIS (confirmed semesters, programme window, results history). The old boxed FULLY PAID/OUTSTANDING chip is gone.
- **Fee balance** moved to a dedicated stat tile (with the count-up animation), and the redundant registration tile became **Programme progress** ("Year 2 of 3").
- Landing page + update manifest are now live, so the forced-update gate is fully operational.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zoofam26/aris3-app/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zoofam26/aris3-app/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1
